_metadata.author: genuine-price CORRECTNESS build — Wave D KPI
_metadata.definition: usable_exact_genuine = (exact requested SKU/variant AND native BHD AND a current in-stock PDP price AND a valid PDP URL) / ALL requested products (including those that PEND). Provenance (source_method in GENUINE_BH_SOURCE_METHODS) is necessary but NOT sufficient — the price must also be the EXACT product and in-stock on a valid PDP.
_metadata.how_measured: scripts/eval_runner.usable_exact_genuine_for_product(body, idx, truth_entry): a product COUNTS as usable_exact_genuine iff its response price (a) is NOT pending/unavailable, (b) has a source_method in GENUINE_BH_SOURCE_METHODS, (c) in_stock is not False, (d) carries a valid PDP url (present and not a listing/search surface), and (e) is_exact_match(truth.expected_identity, price.title-or-name/the resolved query, truth.category). Measure COLD (nocache=true) and WARMED (--read-cache) SEPARATELY.
_metadata.gate: Phase 2 (warmer activation) is gated on usable_exact_genuine >= 0.85 for electronics, fashion, and fragrances on this NON-CIRCULAR truth set, measured WARMED.
_metadata.non_circular: These products are DELIBERATELY DISJOINT from data/warmer_catalog.json (Phase 2 warms that set; reading it back would measure the warm, not correctness). tests/test_kpi_set_disjoint_from_warmer.py pins the disjointness.
_metadata.expansion: SEED set (single-product, canonical exact-SKU query forms). Phase 2 expands each category to 30-50 real BH-available SKUs with a Serper-verified current genuine BHD reference band, then runs the COLD + WARMED eval. Authoring the full set is Serper-heavy and belongs in the Phase-2 session.
_metadata.id_prefix: kpi- (never collides with gold 'q-' or warmer 'warm-' ids)
_metadata.revised: 2026-07-02 — electronics modernized to current BH retail (S25/S25U/iPadAir-M3/MBA-M5/Switch-2, live-probed sharafdg Algolia + extra Unbxd + noon; the 2026-06-27 SKUs were 4/6 discontinued or zero in-stock+priced at BH retail), fashion queries aligned to GCC listing names (GCC titles never carry US marketing names: RB3025 drops 'Classic', L1212 drops 'Classic Fit', Tommy family is 'Essential Flag'). MBA-M5 note: the M5 line's base SSD is 512GB (no 256GB config at BH retail; M4 256GB is OOS at both stores). Switch-2 note: the truth query must NOT contain 'Console' — extra.com's genuine title ('Nintendo Switch 2, Light Blue and Light Red') has no console token and would fail the query-subset gate. Freshness: run scripts/probe_truth_freshness.py before every KPI gate so a RED gate is never blamed on retired SKUs.
